title: Old Książ ruins
visualBrief: Roofless romantic ruin with its own mapped masonry traces, broken high facade, real pointed openings, lower rectangular windows, dressed-stone arched portal and low open courtyard walls.

nativeAxes.origin: Own site envelope center; Y0 estimated lowest local retaining wall contact

sourceFacts.primaryDescription: Independent Stary Książ ruin, own way/239074431, Q9386558 and NID A/5214/621. Surviving appearance follows primary 2014 photographs and an interior panorama; wall associations and heights are proposed.

reconstruction.basis: Own attributed envelope and four mapped castle-wall polylines, primary 2014 exterior/side photographs and an interior panorama.
reconstruction.scope: Roofless surviving masonry and open courtyards. No restored roofs, historical rooms, surrounding trees or cliff reconstruction.
reconstruction.registration: Map axis/anchor only. Real terrain and photographic wall association require geographic review.

geographicProposal.notes: Own named ruin envelope and four separately mapped surviving wall traces. Envelope is not a solid building footprint. Heights, breaks, wall thickness, openings and photographic facade associations are proposed. Terrain/contact review is pending.

sourceLicense: Original authored geometry under repository license. Mapped outline © OpenStreetMap contributors,ODbL-1.0;linked research photographs are not redistributed.
limitations: Exterior component only; the full N0291 site remains incomplete.
Own attributed site envelope and four wall traces. Surviving wall heights, openings and broken profiles are photographic interpretations; there is no roof.
